description: Create a monitor that checks a public page on a schedule and records changes. Returns monitor id, manage token (shown once), feed and events URLs. Free plan: checks every 60 minutes or slower, 3 active monitors per client, 30 days.

mode.description: What to extract. Default text for extract_page, page for watch_page.

paid.description: true: use the paid endpoint (x402). The result is the payment requirements unless a payment header is sent.

selector.description: CSS selector (required for text, attr, list).

webhook_url.description: https URL for signed change notifications.

name: watch_page
